name: Outscraper API
summary: Scrape Google Maps, Yelp, and other directories at scale for lead lists.
whatItDoes: Bulk-extracts business listings beyond standard API limits — useful for building local lead lists with emails, social links, and review data for outbound prospecting.
actionsSupported: Export results to CSV or webhook
privacyNotes: Scraped data may include personal emails — verify CAN-SPAM and GDPR before outreach. Check Outscraper terms for data retention limits.
